verdict.rationale: Twenty documents batch create, update and delete of up to 60 records per request over both REST and GraphQL, plus GraphQL batch upsert. It also offers bulk CSV/XLSX import with field mapping and duplicate detection, unlimited API import, exports of up to 20,000 records, and workflow Iterator steps for processing many records. These together deliver the core of bulk operations for programmatic users. Missing for 10: documented in-UI multi-select bulk edit/delete, evidence that AI agents or the MCP server perform bulk actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of batch behavior at scale.
